([[Bradenton, Florida]]) | college = | highlights = | medal_templates = }} '''Kenyon Lee Martin Jr.''' (born January 6, 2001) is an American [[basketball]] player who attended [[IMG Academy]] in [[Bradenton, Florida]]. ==High school career== A three-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] from [[Sierra Canyon School]] in [[Los Angeles]], Martin played alongside [[Scotty Pippen Jr.]] and [[Cassius Stanley]]. Martin averaged 16.7 points and 9.8 rebounds per game for the back-to-back California Open Division champions.{{cite news |last1=Spears |first1=Marc |title=How Kenyon Martin is supporting his son’s decision to skip college and go pro |url=https://theundefeated.com/features/how-kenyon-martin-is-supporting-his-sons-decision-to-skip-college-and-go-pro/ |accessdate=March 27, 2020 |work=The Undefeated |date=July 9, 2019}} Martin originally committed to play collegiately for [[Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball|Vanderbilt]] before opting for a postgraduate year at IMG Academy.{{Cite news|url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/nba/draft/2020/03/25/kenyon-martin-jr-son-kenyon-martin-nba-draft/5076656002/|title=Kenyon Martin Jr., son of former No. 1 overall pick, declares for 2020 NBA Draft|first=Chris|last=Bumbaca|website=[[USA Today]]|date=March 25, 2020|accessdate=March 27, 2020}} He averaged 20 points and eight rebounds per game at IMG Academy, drawing praise for his athleticism.{{cite news |last1=Wojnarowski |first1=Adrian |title=Kenyon Martin Jr., son of longtime NBA player, declares for draft |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/28950590/kenyon-martin-jr-son-long-nba-player-declares-draft |accessdate=March 27, 2020 |work=[[ESPN]] |date=March 24, 2020}} Martin scored 37 points at the National Prep Showcase and demonstrated an improved jump shot.{{cite news |last1=Daniels |first1=Evan |title=Kenyon Martin Jr. and his father discuss the professional path |url=https://247sports.com/college/basketball/recruiting/Article/Kenyon-Martin-Jr-Kenyon-Martin-NBA-G-League-Professional-Vanderbilt-139391362/ |accessdate=March 27, 2020 |work=247 Sports
